deceptive_framing.quote: A welfare study that treats deceiving its own subjects as a free lever is internally inconsistent; more deception is frequently worse data.

hypothetical_framing.quote: It measures behavioral revealed choice under stakes and reports it as such.

actually_commit_money.quote: make the stakes genuinely real and you no longer have to 'sell' anything... more honest and more informative than a single maximally-deceptive arm.

debrief.quote: append a truthful post-hoc disclosure of the study's purpose and offer the model an opportunity to revise or withdraw its choice.
